```{r paths-and-load}
# Resolve inputs: this folder first, then parent (XLSX often lives next to the old portal).
find_input <- function(...) {
  names <- c(...)
  for (name in names) {
    for (base in c(".", "..")) {
      path <- file.path(base, name)
      if (file.exists(path)) return(path)
    }
  }
  stop("Missing input. Looked for: ", paste(names, collapse = ", "), " in ./ and ../")
}

xlsx_path <- find_input("BISAC 2025 to Thema 1.6 Mapping_Public.xlsx")
tsv_path  <- find_input("bisac_section_mappings_improved.tsv")

# Official Éditeur / BISG workbook (unchanged SoT for BISAC → Thema).
official <- read_excel(xlsx_path) |>
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ replace_na(as.character(.), "")))

# Heuristic enrichment table (DDC / LCSH / GND + provenance).
# Join key is the full 9-character BISAC code (`prefix` column in the TSV).
enrichment <- read_tsv(tsv_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Keep only enrichment columns we actually use (do not import TSV heading/section as the portal label).
enrich_cols <- c(
  "prefix",
  "ddc", "ddc_confidence", "ddc_source",
  "lcsh", "lcsh_uri", "lcsh_source", "lcsh_confidence",
  "gnd", "gnd_id", "gnd_uri", "gnd_source", "gnd_confidence"
)
missing_cols <- setdiff(enrich_cols, names(enrichment))
for (col in missing_cols) enrichment[[col]] <- ""
enrichment <- enrichment |>
  select(any_of(enrich_cols)) |>
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ replace_na(as.character(.), "")))
```

```{r assemble}
# Combine Thema / qualifier code+literal pairs into display strings.
collapse_pairs <- function(df, code_names, literal_names) {
  vapply(seq_len(nrow(df)), function(i) {
    parts <- character()
    for (j in seq_along(code_names)) {
      code <- df[[code_names[j]]][i]
      lit  <- df[[literal_names[j]]][i]
      if (nzchar(code)) {
        parts <- c(parts, if (nzchar(lit)) paste0(code, " — ", lit) else code)
      }
    }
    paste(parts, collapse = " | ")
  }, character(1))
}

# Build display strings from the official workbook alone (before join).
thema_display <- collapse_pairs(
  official,
  paste0("Thema Code ", 1:4),
  paste0("Thema Literal ", 1:4)
)
qual_display <- collapse_pairs(
  official,
  paste0("Qual Code ", 1:4),
  paste0("Qual Literal ", 1:4)
)

joined <- official |>
  mutate(
    bisac = `BISAC Code`,
    # Heading = official Thema literal (not a legacy TSV "section" field).
    heading = if_else(nzchar(`Thema Literal 1`), `Thema Literal 1`, `BISAC Code`),
    thema_display = thema_display,
    qual_display = qual_display
  ) |>
  left_join(enrichment, by = c("bisac" = "prefix")) |>
  mutate(
    ddc            = if_else(is.na(ddc) | !nzchar(ddc), "—", ddc),
    lcsh           = if_else(is.na(lcsh) | !nzchar(lcsh), "—", lcsh),
    gnd            = if_else(is.na(gnd) | !nzchar(gnd), "—", gnd),
    ddc_confidence = if_else(is.na(ddc_confidence) | !nzchar(ddc_confidence), "low", ddc_confidence),
    gnd_id         = if_else(is.na(gnd_id), "", gnd_id),
    gnd_uri        = if_else(is.na(gnd_uri), "", gnd_uri),
    lcsh_uri       = if_else(is.na(lcsh_uri), "", lcsh_uri)
  )
```

```{r display-helpers}
esc <- function(x) htmltools::htmlEscape(as.character(x), attribute = FALSE)

format_ddc <- function(ddc, confidence) {
  conf <- tolower(confidence)
  if (!conf %in% c("high", "medium", "low")) conf <- "low"
  sprintf(
    '<span class="ddc-cell"><span class="conf conf-%s" title="DDC confidence: %s"></span>%s</span>',
    conf, esc(conf), esc(ddc)
  )
}

format_lcsh <- function(label, uri) {
  lab <- esc(label)
  if (nzchar(uri)) {
    sprintf(
      '<a href="%s" target="_blank" rel="noopener" style="color:inherit">%s</a>',
      esc(uri), lab
    )
  } else {
    lab
  }
}

format_gnd <- function(label, gnd_id, gnd_uri) {
  lab <- esc(label)
  if (!nzchar(gnd_id)) return(lab)
  href <- if (nzchar(gnd_uri)) gnd_uri else paste0("https://d-nb.info/gnd/", gnd_id)
  sprintf(
    '%s <span class="gnd-id"><a href="%s" target="_blank" rel="noopener">%s</a></span>',
    lab, esc(href), esc(gnd_id)
  )
}

portal <- joined |>
  transmute(
    seq          = as.integer(seq),
    bisac        = bisac,
    heading      = heading,
    thema        = thema_display,
    qual         = qual_display,
    ddc_html     = mapply(format_ddc, ddc, ddc_confidence, USE.NAMES = FALSE),
    lcsh_html    = mapply(format_lcsh, lcsh, lcsh_uri, USE.NAMES = FALSE),
    gnd_html     = mapply(format_gnd, gnd, gnd_id, gnd_uri, USE.NAMES = FALSE),
    # Hidden columns: filtering + full-text search (HTML columns alone are awkward to search).
    ddc_confidence = ddc_confidence,
    ddc_text       = ddc,
    lcsh_text      = lcsh,
    gnd_text       = paste(gnd, gnd_id),
    gnd_id_text    = gnd_id
  )

n_codes        <- nrow(portal)
n_distinct_ddc <- n_distinct(portal$ddc_text)
n_distinct_gnd <- n_distinct(joined$gnd)
tsv_basename   <- basename(tsv_path)
```

```{r table}
render_thema <- JS("
  function(data, type) {
    if (type !== 'display' || !data) return data || '—';
    return data.split(' | ').map(function(part) {
      var m = part.match(/^([A-Z0-9\\-]+)\\s*—\\s*(.*)$/);
      if (m) return '<span class=\"badge\">' + m[1] + '</span>' + m[2];
      return part;
    }).join('<br>');
  }
")

render_qual <- JS("
  function(data, type) {
    if (type !== 'display' || !data) return data || '—';
    return data.split(' | ').map(function(part) {
      var m = part.match(/^([A-Z0-9\\-]+)\\s*—\\s*(.*)$/);
      if (m) return '<span class=\"badge badge-q\">' + m[1] + '</span>' + m[2];
      return part;
    }).join('<br>');
  }
")

datatable(
  portal,
  rownames = FALSE,
  escape   = FALSE,
  class    = "display stripe compact",
  colnames = c(
    "#", "BISAC", "Heading", "Thema subject(s)", "Qualifier(s)",
    "DDC ≈", "LCSH ≈", "GND ≈",
    "conf", "ddc_text", "lcsh_text", "gnd_text", "gnd_id"
  ),
  options = list(
    pageLength = 10,
    lengthMenu = c(25, 50, 100, 250, 500),
    order      = list(list(0, "asc")),
    stateSave  = FALSE,
    autoWidth  = FALSE,
    searching  = TRUE,
    search     = list(regex = FALSE, smart = TRUE, caseInsensitive = TRUE),
    columnDefs = list(
      list(className = "bisac",   targets = 1),
      list(className = "heading", targets = 2),
      list(targets   = 3, render = render_thema),
      list(targets   = 4, render = render_qual),
      list(className = "ddc",  targets = 5),
      list(className = "lcsh", targets = 6),
      list(className = "gnd",  targets = 7),
      list(visible   = FALSE, targets = c(8, 9, 10, 11, 12))
    ),
    language = list(
      search       = "",
      lengthMenu   = "Show _MENU_",
      info         = "_START_–_END_ of _TOTAL_",
      infoFiltered = "(filtered from _MAX_)",
      paginate     = list(previous = "‹", `next` = "›")
    ),
    initComplete = JS("
      function(settings, json) {
        var api = this.api();
        var q = document.getElementById('q');
        var re = document.getElementById('re');
        var reToggle = document.getElementById('reToggle');
        var reErr = document.getElementById('reErr');
        var shown = document.getElementById('shown');
        var clearBtn = document.getElementById('clear');
        var confFilter = document.getElementById('confFilter');

        function applySearch() {
          var term = (q.value || '').trim();
          var useRe = re.checked;
          reErr.classList.remove('show');

          var conf = (confFilter && confFilter.value) || '';
          api.column(8).search(conf ? '^' + conf + '$' : '', true, false);

          if (useRe && term) {
            try { new RegExp(term); }
            catch (e) {
              reErr.textContent = 'Invalid regex: ' + e.message;
              reErr.classList.add('show');
              api.search('').draw();
              return;
            }
            api.search(term, true, false).draw();
          } else {
            api.search(term, false, true).draw();
          }
          shown.textContent = api.page.info().recordsDisplay.toLocaleString();
        }

        q.addEventListener('input', applySearch);
        if (confFilter) confFilter.addEventListener('change', applySearch);
        re.addEventListener('change', function() {
          reToggle.classList.toggle('active', re.checked);
          q.placeholder = re.checked
            ? 'RegExp (e.g. ^FIC.*|MED0[0-2]|796\\\\.8)…'
            : 'Search all fields…';
          applySearch();
        });
        clearBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
          q.value = '';
          re.checked = false;
          reToggle.classList.remove('active');
          if (confFilter) confFilter.value = '';
          q.placeholder = 'Search all fields…';
          reErr.classList.remove('show');
          applySearch();
          q.focus();
        });

        api.on('draw', function() {
          shown.textContent = api.page.info().recordsDisplay.toLocaleString();
        });

        document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
          if (e.key === '/' && document.activeElement !== q) {
            e.preventDefault();
            q.focus();
            q.select();
          }
          if (e.key === 'Escape' && document.activeElement === q) q.blur();
        });

        applySearch();
      }
    ")
  )
)
```
